description: Synthetic customer-resource overlay on the unchanged paper15 feeder; not a reproduction of the Dutch or Swiss networks.
placement_rule: Six predefined terminal meter IDs spaced through the public terminal-label list; no branch, fitted H, truth, posterior or prospective DR outcome used.

pricing.status: Illustrative yuan quotations, not observed/calibrated market prices; node differences are declared assumptions.
pricing.accounting: Primary cost is service compensation. The separate net-energy value sums customer-terminal powers, excludes network losses and is not automatically the DSO's own cash bill. EV/thermal compensation uses absolute changes, including rebound; do not also charge a full per-shifted-kWh fee.

sources.used: PV 4.5 kW DC/3.75 kVA inverter; 230 V x 16 A EV charger, efficiency 90%, daily energy scale 7.5 kWh; COP 3, 1000 L reference tank and 40-55 C temperature range.
sources.difference: Our feeder, device count/placement, 2 kW thermal power, connection windows, heat-demand profile, 0.98 retention and monetary quotations are synthetic choices. We explicitly interpret 7.5 kWh as battery-side energy.

sources.location: Methods: heat pumps, electric vehicles and grid integration
sources.used: Separate inflexible demand from allocated DERs; V1G charging with power/energy limits and thermal flexibility.
sources.difference: Swiss deployment counts and projected adoption shares are not copied to this feeder.
